review_scope: Independent re-review of the 2026-11-12 corrected draft (r1 review task BLO-4963): primary sources re-opened, run records re-read, artifact hashes recomputed, record-fidelity findings re-tested.
review_notes: No JetBrains IDE was available: the failure was not reproduced and no IDE-side log exists; the article says so twice and results.json now records ide_build_checked: false.

Deviation from the research plan is disclosed in the article's evidence method.md: the planned 'minimum IDE build' defect was dropped because FORMAT.md documents no such field, and replaced with a platform-gap defect.
public_artifacts privacy review is requested, not self-approved: the writer assessed the files as containing no personal data, but the independent reviewer decides.

Correction run (this submission) fixed the published-record mismatch: run_defects.py now derives the checker header from the argv it executes (no hand-written flag list) and passes no --ide-build value; fixtures/, transcripts/, checker/ and results.json were regenerated in a single run; results.json gained wall_clock_s and ide_build_checked plus a host_note; method.md and the article's failure-point count (seven) and wall clock (2.6 s) were corrected; every public_artifacts and first_party_test sha256 below was recomputed from the new bytes.

APPROVED 2026-11-12T19:14:38Z: the previous blocking record-fidelity findings are fixed in the published bytes - checker/<case>.txt headers are generated from the executed argv, no --ide-build value is passed (results.json ide_build_checked:false, host_note present), checker logs contain no 'ide_build:' line, and the article's seven-place count matches the seven-item pre-flight. All 17 declared artifacts and the 10 fixture files hash-match. Limitations (stdio citation target, 'first failure' exit wording, synthetic non-gzip payload names, 2-minute schema dateModified drift) are non-blocking and recorded in research/<slug>-review.json.

claims.note: Title and description name the package id and bucket token from the user-reported log line, and the description's 'five distinct server-side signatures' plus 'six loopback cases' match the run records in results.json. Description does not claim IDE-side reproduction.

Demand framing is the selection's measured query row (Bing, 2 impressions / 1 click, 2026-11-06) recorded in research/<slug>.json demand_evidence; the sentence claims only that one reader searched the line, and the article nowhere calls the failure common or widespread. Reviewer should confirm against the brief.

The seven failure points are each a documented element of the registry index contract or the documented install procedure: index fetch, entry presence, required fields incl. license_url, platform distribution selection, artifact fetch, sha256 comparison, and the runtime step. Five of the seven are injected as defects in run/results.json (index_fetch, entry_schema, distribution_select, artifact_fetch, artifact_sha256); entry_present and runtime_node are implemented by the checker but are not injected as defective cases in this fixture. No claim is made about the client's internal mapping.
Field list, license_url requirement and exemption, distribution types, platform keys, supported archive formats and the optional status of sha256 are quoted from FORMAT.md as fetched 2026-11-12.

Dedicated JetBrains index URL, preview channel and hourly regeneration are from README.md; the claude-acp 0.106.0 entry, its per-platform binary with sha256 and npx fallback, and environments.node 24.22.1 are read from the live index snapshot. The environments block is labelled correlation, not a documented mechanism.

engines.node '>=22' and the claude-agent-acp bin are quoted from the published npm metadata and the package.json; the CI authMethods verification is the README/launch-post statement. The article explicitly separates an auth-conformance pass from an artifact existing for a platform.

Environment line records the versions host emitted by run_defects.py into results.json (python 3.12.3, node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0, Linux 6.17.0 aarch64) plus the wall clock the run itself recorded as results.json wall_clock_s (2.59 s, rounded to 2.6 in prose). Target platform linux-x86_64 was passed to the checker, no artifact was executed, and results.json states ide_build_checked: false because no IDE build was passed.

run.methodology: Loopback stub ACP registry (stdlib http.server) with one injected contract defect per case; checker invocation and server-side JSONL transcript captured per case; six cases in one run, wall clock 2.6 s recorded as results.json wall_clock_s, environment recorded in results.json. No IDE build is passed and no third-party code executed; results.json records ide_build_checked: false.
